resources.string: No phone number and no email: people find you only by your username, and Velo always connects through Tor.
Open Contacts to add someone by their username, or send them an invite. Team Velo may already be in your contacts: write there for questions or problems, the developer answers.
Share a story from the top of the chat list: only the contacts you choose see it, and it disappears after 24 hours. In Profile you can add more accounts and switch between them.
